---
title: "BoolNet R"
---

`boolnet` is an R package for generating, reconstructing, and analyzing Boolean networks. It simulates synchronous, asynchronous, and probabilistic update, and it is commonly used to find attractors, draw state-transition graphs, and test how a network responds to perturbation.

* <https://cran.r-project.org/package=BoolNet>

This page is a placeholder and a work in progress.
